key_points: WDC caught in broad AI infrastructure/memory selloff; stock down ~17% on AI spending concerns.
No company-specific earnings, guidance, regulatory, or M&A news; move is mostly sector-driven.
Druckenmiller's new WDC stake is a modest positive signal but 13F is lagged and stocks have fallen since.
Officer stock sale of $6.17M is a minor negative sentiment item, not thesis-changing.
Analyst optimism and upcoming presentations are unlikely to offset near-term AI trade de-risking.
